chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Emerges from Hell with Sacred Relics, Faces Jie Sect
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen escapes hell laden with sacred artifacts; Keke enters deep sleep. He must confront powerful Jie Sect cultivators including Chengzi. A stunning display of armaments leaves even ancient gods speechless.
og_title: Sacred Relics Ablaze: Xiao Chen's Armament Shocks the Jie Sect
og_description: Xiao Chen emerges from hell armed with the Four Immortal-Slaying Swords and more. Keke slumbers. Chengzi and his disciples are caught off guard by Xiao Chen's arsenal.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Overloads on Holy Relics, Crushes Jie Sect Attack
twitter_description: Armed to the teeth with legendary artifacts, Xiao Chen faces the Jie Sect. But Keke's sleep and the weight of his enemies may prove too much.
